blue: Use case: compositing, watercolor game UI sprites. Create ONE transparent sprite sheet containing EXACTLY TWO circular action selectors side by side in TWO EQUAL SQUARE CELLS (2:1 landscape sheet), equal size and aligned. Use Image1 for exact brass-frame, cream-parchment watercolor rice-paper texture and circular central transparent hole style. IMPORTANT reverse action positions compared with Image1: in BOTH circles the LEFT SEMICIRCULAR sector contains a visibly BROKEN BLUE CRYSTAL (remove tower), RIGHT sector contains INTACT BLUE CRYSTAL GROUP (upgrade tower). Each circle has exactly two equal halves divided vertically at 12 and 6 o'clock, central transparent hole. First circle (left cell) upgrade icon matches Image2: one large blue crystal plus ONE smaller blue crystal beside its lower right, two crystals total. Second circle (right cell) upgrade icon matches Image3: one large blue crystal plus TWO smaller satellites, three total. In both circles deletion icon is the SAME shattered crystal: a pointed top fragment separated by jagged gaps from lower chunky broken pieces, plus a few small shards below, clearly broken NOT intact satellite group. Icons upright, centered within own sector, compact about 28% cell height, never overlap central hole. All sectors neutral cream idle backgrounds, bright brass frames, restrained crystal light. Each circle fills about86% of square cell width and height with generous equal margins, no artwork or border crossing between cells. GENUINE transparent outer canvas, gap between circles, and circular hole in each circle. No text, headings, labels, numbers, coins, arrows, extra buttons, map or scene. This layout is STRICTLY: left remove / right upgrade in BOTH circles.
